_README: DO NOT COMMIT THIS FILE. Contains prepared payload for Synthesis project update. API key must be injected at runtime.

_API_REFERENCE.note: Published projects remain editable until hackathon ends (March 22). Updating trackUUIDs REPLACES all existing assignments, so include ALL desired tracks.

conversationLog.title: Discovery & Architecture
conversationLog.summary: Read ERC-8004 spec. Enumerated all 1,855 agents on Celo IdentityRegistry. Built metadata parser supporting 5 encoding formats (gzip-base64, base64, IPFS, HTTP, raw JSON). Discovered ValidationRegistry is not deployed on Celo, so pivoted to ReputationRegistry for on-chain attestations.
decisions: Use ReputationRegistry instead of ValidationRegistry (not deployed on Celo)
Support 5 metadata formats to handle real-world encoding diversity

conversationLog.title: 5-Layer Scoring Engine with Circuit Breakers
conversationLog.summary: Designed and implemented 5-layer composite scoring (0-100): L1 Registration Quality, L2 Endpoint Liveness, L3 On-Chain Behavior, L4 Sybil/Spam Detection, L5 Existing Reputation. Added circuit breakers that cap scores when critical flags fire (MASS_REGISTRATION caps at 15, NO_METADATA at 20, METADATA_CLONE at 25). Tested against known agents: Arca #2 (fair score), babycaisubagent cluster #50-1670 (correctly capped at 15 for Sybil spam). Scoring is fully deterministic with no LLM in the pipeline.
decisions: Cap mass registrars at 15/100 regardless of other scores
Deterministic scoring only (no LLM, no randomness)
Circuit breakers ensure one strong negative signal overrides easy-to-game positives

conversationLog.title: On-Chain Attestation Writes & IPFS Pipeline
conversationLog.summary: Wrote 1,854 trust attestations to ReputationRegistry via giveFeedback(). Registered Sentinel8004 as agent #1853 on IdentityRegistry (TX: 0x336764f2...e47f). Built IPFS pinning pipeline via Pinata. Discovered hardcoded 200K gas limit caused silent reverts across 90% of agents. Fixed by letting the node estimate gas per-tx. Self-feedback correctly blocked by contract design (cannot score own agent).
decisions: Let node estimate gas per-tx instead of hardcoding (200K caused silent reverts)
Skip self-feedback (contract blocks it, which is correct anti-gaming behavior)
Sequential nonce management to avoid Celo nonce collisions

conversationLog.title: MCP Server & Dashboard
conversationLog.summary: Built MCP server exposing 3 tools for AI-to-AI queries: check_agent_trust(agentId), list_flagged_agents(maxScore, limit), get_agent_report(agentId). Built static dashboard with search, sort, and agent detail views. Deployed to GitHub Pages. Chose static site over server-rendered for simplicity and free hosting.
decisions: Static site on GitHub Pages (simpler, free, no server to maintain)
MCP protocol for agent-to-agent trust queries

conversationLog.title: Bug Fixes & Data Integrity
conversationLog.summary: Fixed 3 bugs found during verification: (1) reputation.ts called readFeedback with index 0 but contract requires >= 1 (1-based indexing). (2) liveness.ts had operator precedence bug in parking page detection. (3) onchain.ts missing .toLowerCase() on tx.input for case safety. Documented that pre-fix on-chain attestations for agents #1849/#1850 are immutable. Updated on-chain metadata from AgentGuard to Sentinel8004.
decisions: Document pre-fix scores as known limitations rather than hiding them
Rename from AgentGuard to Sentinel8004 after discovering existing AgentGuard agent on Base

conversationLog.title: Hackathon Submissions & Ecosystem Report
conversationLog.summary: Researched both hackathons (Build Agents V2 + The Synthesis). Submitted to Karma Gap (ref: APP-SGZ0Y1A7-V4XQWM). Registered on Synthesis, created project draft, published as sentinel8004-4cff. Self-custody transfer completed to 0x67FbCB8A3C9136eAA83A550ef0aA17a5549aFB52 on Base. Generated agent_log.json with full execution log. Key findings from ecosystem scan: 97.6% of agents flagged, one address owns 500+ babycaisubagent clones, 88% score below 10.
decisions: Submit to both hackathons (prizes are independent)
Open Track added for maximum coverage ($28K+ prize pool)

conversationLog.title: Deep Architecture Audit
conversationLog.summary: First-principles audit of the entire system. Discovered L5 reputation layer was compromised: 1,797 sock puppet wallets across 3 agents (Toppa #1870: 431 puppets, Loopuman #17: 936 puppets, Agent #1865: 437 puppets) were inflating scores through the ReputationRegistry. Zero legitimate third-party scorers exist -- 466/480 scored agents are Sentinel-only. getSummary on mainnet was returning attacker-controlled data. Contract owner identified as Leonard Tan (Web3Auth CTO). IPFS hash integrity verified 5/5.
decisions: L5 must filter providers by tx history + funding independence
Need revoke-before-rescore for corrected attestations
TrustGate consumer library needed for safe score consumption

conversationLog.title: L5 Anti-Sybil Fix & IPFS Provider Migration
conversationLog.summary: Fixed L5 reputation layer with 3 anti-Sybil filters: (1) exclude Sentinel's own writer address from client list, (2) exclude providers with <5 total txs (sock puppet filter via Blockscout), (3) uniformity filter flags all scores >90 from qualified providers as SYBIL_BOOSTED. Verified on live chain: Toppa 431 puppets filtered, Loopuman 936 filtered, Agent #1865 437 filtered. Added Filebase as primary IPFS provider (S3-compatible, 5GB free) after Pinata limits hit. Added revokeFeedback capability to writer.
decisions: 3-filter anti-Sybil approach catches coordinated attacks at multiple levels
Filebase S3 chosen over Lighthouse for IPFS (simpler auth, higher limits)
IPFS provider priority: Filebase > Lighthouse > Pinata

conversationLog.title: Incremental Rescan & L5 Correction
conversationLog.summary: Incremental rescan added 317 new agents (IDs 2903-3219), bringing total to 3,219. L5 re-scored for agents with non-zero reputation: Toppa #1870 dropped from 95 to 80 (430 sock puppets filtered, SYBIL_BOOSTED flag set). Orbiting Parity #2259 stayed at 15 (1 legitimate external client with 85+ txs passed filters). Dashboard regenerated with corrected scores.
decisions: Incremental scan approach (only new agents) saves RPC calls and time
SYBIL_BOOSTED flag is informational -- score capping happens via circuit breaker

conversationLog.title: On-Chain Write Pipeline Hardening
conversationLog.summary: Found writer was re-writing agents 1-12 (wasted gas). Binary search identified on-chain cutoff at agent 2338. Rebuilt write-results.json with 2,338 entries marked as already-written. Fixed dry-run mode to not overwrite write-results.json. Batch 2: 231 agents written. Batch 3: 9 agents before Filebase quota hit. Total on-chain: 2,569 of 3,219. Added IPFS provider fallback logic (tries all providers in order instead of fail-fast). 650 agents remaining, blocked on IPFS provider.
decisions: write-results.json merge instead of overwrite preserves prior on-chain data
IPFS fallback chain prevents single provider failure from blocking writes

conversationLog.title: Scoring Critique & SYBIL_BOOSTED Circuit Breaker
conversationLog.summary: Deep scoring critique found 6 bugs. Critical fix: SYBIL_BOOSTED flag was set by L5 but never capped the score. Toppa scored 80 despite 431 sock puppets. Added SYBIL_BOOSTED to circuit breaker map with cap at 40. Toppa now correctly scores 40/100. Fixed reporter L5 adversarial analysis (was 'Very High' cost, actually 'Low ~$5'). Added local CID computation via ipfs-only-hash as IPFS fallback -- computes identical CIDs without uploading. Unblocked batch 4 write of remaining 650 agents. 22/22 tests pass.
decisions: SYBIL_BOOSTED circuit breaker cap at 40 (below NO_METADATA at 20 but above MASS_REGISTRATION at 15)
Local CID computation as ultimate fallback when all IPFS providers fail
Corrected top 5: AgentDashboard 85, CRIA 77, Celo GovAI Hub 75, Fixr 74, OG_Bot 72

_NOTES.updateMethod: POST /projects/:projectUUID (NOT PUT or PATCH). Devfolio/Synthesis uses POST for updates.

_NOTES.publishedEditable: Published projects remain editable until hackathon end (March 22, 11:59pm PST).
